articles.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
articles.content: Test using prompts with unique, trackable secrets proves that data doesn't stay private.
articles.titleZh: 研究人员在人工智能供应链中植入了 200 万只“金丝雀”。一场隐私灾难浮出水面。
articles.contentZh: 使用包含唯一且可追踪密钥的提示语进行测试，结果证明数据无法保持私密性。

articles.title: Man hired by Russia spied on Silicon Valley tech and defense company, feds say
articles.content: 25-year-old accused of stalking employees at coffee shop and in an "aggressive" car pursuit.
articles.titleZh: 联邦调查局称，一名受雇于俄罗斯的男子曾对硅谷的科技和国防公司进行间谍活动
articles.contentZh: 一名25岁的男子被指控在咖啡店尾随员工，并“咄咄逼人”地驾车追逐。

articles.title: How to tell a cyberattack from a plain old outage
articles.content: When everything goes down, don’t assume it’s a cyberattack.
articles.titleZh: 如何区分网络攻击和普通的停机故障
articles.contentZh: 当一切都瘫痪时，不要想当然地认为这是网络攻击。

articles.title: Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors
articles.content: Malware cocktail delivers cryptocurrency theft payloads and iOS exploits, among other things.
articles.titleZh: 数百个网站向毫无戒心的访客提供强大的恶意软件组合
articles.contentZh: 恶意软件组合会传播加密货币盗窃载荷和 iOS 漏洞利用等内容。

articles.title: Google alternative Kagi launches an email service
articles.content: Kagi, which already offers a paid alternative to Google Search and its own Orion browser as a rival to Chrome, is taking on another Google service: Gmail. articles.titleZh: Google 替代搜索引擎 Kagi 推出了电子邮件服务
articles.contentZh: Kagi已经提供了Google搜索的付费替代品，以及与Chrome竞争的自有Orion浏览器，现在又将进军另一项Google服务：Gmail。今天，Kagi宣布推出Kagi Mail的公开测试版，这是一项全新的电子邮件服务，具有“无监控、无广告、开放标准和无锁定”的特点。使用Kagi Mail，您可以[…]

articles.title: The hacker behind early GTA VI leaks has been sentenced — and released
articles.content: Arion Kurtaj, who pleaded guilty last week to hacking Grand Theft Auto VI developer Rockstar Games and other companies, including Uber and Revolut, was sentenced to seven years in prison but released on license, the BBC reports. After hacking Rockstar, Kurtaj leaked 90 videos of GTA VI in 2022, years before the game's public release […]
articles.titleZh: 《GTA VI》早期泄露事件背后的黑客已被判刑并获释
articles.contentZh: 据英国广播公司报道，上周对黑客入侵《侠盗猎车手VI》开发商Rockstar Games以及包括优步和Revolut在内的其他公司一事认罪的Arion Kurtaj被判处七年有期徒刑，但获假释释放。在黑入Rockstar后，Kurtaj于2022年泄露了90段《GTA VI》的视频，当时距离该游戏的正式发布还有数年时间……
